name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail stations: surface, underground or elevated, with five lengths and covered platforms.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.16.0 expands API v1 with a modular component design. Designs can inherit defaults, remove optional parts or supply their own platform, shelter, canopy, trees, planters, benches, bins and lights. Custom plain platform and canopy models must declare 20m modules; complete authored modules are not stretched. Track count, platform dimensions/floor height, entrances, stairs and routes remain fixed. Core-owned stair surrounds and short end infills remain standard parts, and the underground hall is fixed. Surface platform canopies are now possible through a design. The standard stations retain the exact full construction output of all 72 pre-contract reference cases; native 40m visuals remain internal adapters. Existing API asset-role consumers remain supported. Actual independent add-on loading and the new component appearance still require an in-game test. No automatic rebuilding; do not remove the mod while its infrastructure remains in a save.
